newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp-Thyssen could boost competitiveness - Rexrodt.
newsitem.headline: Krupp-Thyssen could boost competitiveness - Rexrodt.

text.p: German economics minister Guenter Rexrodt said talks between Krupp and Thyssen on cooperation in the steel sector could help boost the international competitiveness of the German steel industry.
Rexrodt urged the two to find solutions that secure jobs in the sector over the long term.
The two companies' agreement to discuss merging their steel activities "would take their existing cooperation a bit further," Rexrodt said in a statement.

Rexrodt added he had discussed the plan with Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp chairman Gerhard Cromme and Thyssen AG chairman Dieter Vogel, and urged them to keep the best interests of the German steel industry in mind.

"Today's decision by Krupp and Thyssen is remarkable for the fact that the two want to reach the goal of long-term competitiveness on their own power, and have not sought state subsidies, as is often the case in other places," Rexrodt said.
